_readme: PLACEHOLDER DATA pending submission by each club to the Council of Student Activities. Ordering policy: categories are listed alphabetically, and clubs are listed alphabetically within each category - never by size, funding, seniority or founding date. This file is the only place club listings are edited; clubs.html and index.html both read it. See README.md 'No-favouritism policy'.

clubs.name: Abhivyakti - Dramatics Club
clubs.tagline: Stage productions, street plays and improv nights.

clubs.name: Chitra - Fine Arts Club
clubs.tagline: Painting, sketching and the annual campus mural.

clubs.name: Nritya - Dance Club
clubs.tagline: Classical and contemporary dance, open styles.

clubs.name: Taal - Music Club
clubs.tagline: Open mics, jam sessions and the campus band.

clubs.name: Kalam - Literary Club
clubs.tagline: Creative writing circles, poetry slams and a lit-mag.

clubs.name: Lens - Photography Club
clubs.tagline: Covers campus events; annual exhibition each spring.

clubs.name: Reel - Filmmaking Club
clubs.tagline: Short films, documentary shoots and screening nights.

clubs.name: Vaad - Debate & Public Speaking Club
clubs.tagline: Parliamentary debate, MUNs and speaker workshops.

clubs.name: Prakriti - Sustainability Club
clubs.tagline: Campus composting, waste audits and eco-drives.

clubs.name: Seva - Community Outreach Club
clubs.tagline: Teaching drives and outreach with nearby schools.

clubs.name: Field - Athletics Club
clubs.tagline: Track and field training for inter-institute meets.

clubs.name: Smash - Racquet Sports Club
clubs.tagline: Badminton, table tennis and squash ladders.

clubs.name: Strikers - Football Club
clubs.tagline: Campus league and inter-IISER tournament squad.

clubs.name: Astra - Astronomy Club
clubs.tagline: Stargazing nights and a campus telescope build.

clubs.name: Circuit - Electronics Club
clubs.tagline: PCB design workshops and open hardware nights.

clubs.name: Vega - Robotics Club
clubs.tagline: Builds autonomous bots; runs the annual robotics sprint.
